page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-1024 is an x86_64 compute instance designed for large-scale enterprise workloads that demand high computational capability and substantial memory capacity. Powered by AMD EPYC 9J45 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, this instance provisions 64 physical cores with multithreading enabled, supplying 128 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is scaled to 1024 GB, establishing a generous memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per virtual core.

Hardware allocation is focused purely on compute and system memory. The instance features zero bundled local disk storage, requiring external block storage services for operating system volumes and persistent data retention. Furthermore, the configuration excludes GPU hardware accelerators. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address allocated directly to the host instance.

Resource density is a prominent operational factor for this configuration. Offering a full terabyte of system memory across 128 dedicated execution threads enables significant server consolidation, reducing management overhead across distributed virtual fleets. Although workloads requiring high-throughput local disk operations must account for network storage constraints, the large RAM pool accommodates expansive data sets directly in memory. The VM.Standard.E6.Flex.64-1024 is suited for large relational databases, memory-resident analytics, distributed caching tiers, ERP software deployments, and high-concurrency enterprise applications.
